We asked Cape Breton-Canso MP Mike Kelloway questions that we received from the community: are essential workers with underlying health conditions eligible for the Canada Emergency Response Benefit if they refuse to go to work for safety reasons? What if they don't have an underlying health condition but live with someone who does? Here's our April 17 interview.
We’ll be doing weekly segments with the federal MP so we can ask him your questions. You can send them at chne.television@gmail.com.
